toy_check: 站得住：短足着地。物件长进去：箱子就是身体。特殊材质只有搪瓷壳。新组合：扣上却还停在门口的箱人。不像绘本。头像可见箱盖。做得成。姿态：停在门口，不是出发。
crop: 记忆点在箱盖头和肩后短拉杆，头像即可认出。

pose: 停在门口站住，重心稳住
zh: 原创潮玩角色，一只暖灰短绒圆核和一只扁立方行李箱长在一起：整只箱子就是它的身体和头盖，拿掉箱子就没有角色。上半是微微隆起的箱盖，盖沿扣到肩线，几乎没有颈，腹下两枚短钝足，肩后一截短拉杆只伸出头宽以内，并不拉长。半垂小黑豆眼贴在箱盖中下部，极小一字嘴，视线落下。双足左右分开站稳，像旅途已经停在门口，还没有被提走。主体是暖灰短绒，只有箱壳和包角是硬质米黄搪瓷，拉杆是一截姜黄。配色是暖灰配米黄搪瓷，加一点姜黄。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要旅行出发，不要滚动的轮子场景，不要字母贴纸，不要品牌箱纹，不要把手提包当成背饰，不要挥手告别，不要发光。
enp: Original designer toy character: a warm-grey plush rounded core fused with a flat rectangular suitcase — the suitcase is the body and lid-head, without it there is no character. The slightly domed lid sits down to the shoulders, almost no neck, two short blunt feet, a short pull-rod at the back grows out less than one head-width and is not extended. Half-lidded tiny black bean eyes sit on the lower mid-lid, a tiny straight mouth, gaze lowered. Feet planted apart, standing still in a doorway, not being taken away. Body is warm-grey plush; only the shell and corners are hard cream enamel; the rod is a stump of mustard yellow. Colors: warm grey with cream enamel and a mustard accent. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No travel departure, no rolling-wheel scene, no letter stickers, no brand luggage pattern, no handheld bag worn as an accessory, no waving goodbye, no glowing light.
